title: Igneous, sedimentary and metamorphic rocks
log: 2026-11-20T12:15:22Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new
2026-11-20T12:25:59Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

match.reason: No single bank point covers all three rock types and the idea that rocks are made of minerals; the matches (metamorphic, igneous, sedimentary) each teach only one type at more depth, and the rock cycle is broader, so a new point is needed.

draft.title: Igneous, sedimentary and metamorphic rocks
card: Rocks are made of minerals. A mineral is a solid substance that forms naturally in the Earth, such as quartz. Most rocks are a mixture of minerals.
forms when hot melted rock, called magma, cools and hardens. Granite and basalt are examples.
forms when pieces of rock and other material, called sediment, settle in layers and are pressed together. Sandstone is an example.
forms when an existing rock is changed by heat and pressure, without melting completely. Marble and slate are examples.
draft.remember: Igneous rock comes from cooled magma, sedimentary from pressed layers of sediment, and metamorphic from rock changed by heat and pressure.

a.q: A rock is made of layers of sand grains that were pressed together over a long time. Which type of rock is it?
a.why: Sand is sediment, and rock made of pressed layers of sediment is sedimentary. It is not igneous, because that type forms from cooled magma and not from settled grains.
a.clue: Think about what the layers of grains were before they were pressed.

b.q: Limestone is a sedimentary rock. Deep underground, heat and pressure change it into marble without melting it completely. What type of rock is marble?
opts: Metamorphic, because heat and pressure changed it
Sedimentary, because it began as a sedimentary rock
Igneous, because heat was needed to change it
Metamorphic, because it was formed from magma
b.why: Marble is metamorphic because an existing rock was changed by heat and pressure. It is not igneous, because the limestone did not melt completely and cool as magma.
b.clue: Ask how the rock formed now, not what it was before.

b.best: Metamorphic, because heat and pressure changed it
